exposure: lack of prior communication to the theatre team
cohort: Women with category I or II indications delivering by emergency caesarean section at Mbarara Regional Referral Hospital in Southwestern Uganda.
finding: The majority of women undergoing emergency caesarean section experienced a delayed decision-to-delivery interval (median 167.5 min), and predictors for this delay included prior caesarean delivery, need for stabilization, logistical issues like needing to buy sundries, and unavailability of theatre resources or staff.
mod_finding: Prior caesarean delivery was identified as a predictor for a delayed decision-to-delivery interval for the current emergency caesarean section.
